skillTree.localised_description: Servants of Ulric impose hardships upon themselves as a rule, such is their extremity of faith and the stubborn strength it brings.
Those who walk beside the Wolf do not suffer cowardly death, nor does their tenacity abandon them.
While winter takes from some, its cold embrace provides for others.
Those who bear witness to Ar-Ulric's devotion sometimes wonder if the wind itself is not his ally, to carry his prayers on its own.
Ulric’s domain is one of honour, bravery and prowess. His fury is aimed at cowardice and weakness, made known to his followers through prayer.

attributes.bullet_text: This unit frightens all enemy units, reducing their leadership when nearby. It is also immune to fear. Fear penalties do not stack.

skillTree.localised_description: Is it a prayer to war, or a primal acclamation to the Wolf-God? It amounts to all and the same.
Under such eyes, one's martial resolve withers – for behind them is the Wolf, daring you to lay a hand upon him.
To hunt and stalk, one needs time. To kill, one need not waste it.
What was once a full-throated clamour turns into the crush and press of bodies gone feral with bloodlust.

attributes.bullet_text: This unit frightens all enemy units, reducing their leadership when nearby. It is also immune to fear. Fear penalties do not stack.
This unit does not suffer any form of leadership loss and will never rout.

skillTree.localised_description: When the foe's hand is stayed and their resolve stuttered, then their throat is bared – and so are the Wolf's fangs.
As the the enemy's blood gushes hot, the blood still in their veins freezes in a terrible premonition of death.
It is no easy task to bend or break the armour of this being.
There is nothing but utter belief. There is no reasoning with this one.
"Don't look into their eyes, there is only death there!"
Such is this one's conviction that others have no choice but to believe.
Speaking words of power or faith can alter perceptions on the battlefield.
This one will not go down easily - it will be necessary to break both the will and the body first.
An omen, a sign - this being knows things and any who follow will share their glory.
A blade that sings in defence will not let its wielder be penetrated.
This one fights with a fervour to be both admired and despised.
Crushing unworthy foes is no longer enough. For the men who carry Ulric's will, his mandate is to utterly annihilate them.
